items.description: Sec. 2.1/3.1 only say 'cantilever beam (Fig. 1(a))' solved with top88. Which edge is supported, and over what length, is shown only in Fig. 1(a). top88's built-in boundary conditions are for the MBB beam, so the authors changed them, but the text never says how.
readings: Whole left edge supported (x = 0, 0 <= y <= H)
Only part of the left edge supported (e.g. central segment 0.25H-0.75H)
Only the top and bottom ends of the left edge supported
Whole right edge supported, load on the left edge (mirror-image arrangement)

items.description: The text does not say whether the support fixes both displacement components (a clamp) or only some degrees of freedom; only Fig. 1(a) would show it.
readings: Fully clamped: ux = uy = 0 at every node of the supported edge (top88-style fixeddofs = 1:2*(nely+1))
Roller-type: only ux fixed along the edge, plus one node fixed in uy
Pinned (ux = uy = 0) at a few discrete nodes only

items.entity: applied force on the free edge
items.description: Where the force acts is shown only in Fig. 1(a). Sec. 2.1, 2.3 and 3.1 give no coordinates or node.
readings: Free (right) edge at mid-height, y = 0.5H (node 51 of 101): the classic top99/top88 cantilever
Bottom corner of the free edge, y = 0
Top corner of the free edge, y = H

items.entity: applied force on the free edge
items.description: The text does not say whether the load is one nodal force or is spread over several nodes or the whole edge (Fig. 1(a) only).
readings: Single nodal point force
Force spread over a few nodes/elements around the load point
Uniform traction along the whole free edge

items.entity: applied force on the free edge
items.description: The direction is shown only in Fig. 1(a). For a single-load linear compliance problem, flipping the sign (up/down) gives the same layout, but changing the line of action does not.
readings: Vertical, downward (-y), transverse to the beam axis
Vertical, upward (+y): same optimum as downward
Inclined (has a horizontal component)

items.entity: applied force on the free edge
items.description: No force value appears anywhere in the text; top88 uses a unit force by convention.
readings: |F| = 1 (top88 convention)
A physical value such as |F| = 1 kN

items.entity: volume-fraction limit for the run(s) to reproduce
items.description: Sec. 2.3 says targets were made for Vf = 0.01-0.95 in steps of 0.01, then says a narrower range may be used if generation is hard, so the range actually used for the cantilever is unclear. Table 1 compares at Vf = 0.03/0.25/0.50/0.75, and the Vf of the Fig. 3(b) target is not given. Which run(s) count as 'this example' is not specified.
readings: Full sweep 0.01:0.01:0.95 (95 runs)
Narrower sweep in steps of 0.01 (e.g. 0.03-0.95)

items.entity: physical size of the design domain / element size
items.description: Sec. 2.3 gives only the mesh (100x100 elements). That makes the domain square if the elements are top88's unit squares, but no physical length, height or element size is given, so rmin = 2.4 has to be read in element widths.
readings: 100 x 100 length units, element size 1 (top88 convention)
1 x 1 square, element size 0.01 (rmin = 0.024)
Physical size such as 100 mm x 100 mm with 1 mm elements

items.description: The text gives no material data. Only the use of top88 (Sec. 2.1/2.3) points to its defaults.
readings: E0 = 1, thickness = 1 (top88 defaults)
E = 210 GPa (steel), unit thickness
E = 70 GPa (aluminium), unit thickness

items.description: Neither Poisson's ratio nor plane stress vs plane strain is stated. top88 hard-codes nu = 0.3 and plane stress, but the text never says so.
readings: nu = 0.3, plane stress (top88 default)
nu = 0.3, plane strain
nu = 0.25 or 0.33, plane stress

items.description: Sec. 2.3 gives only penal = 3. The form of the SIMP law and the lower stiffness bound for void elements are not stated.
readings: Modified SIMP E = Emin + x^3 (E0 - Emin), Emin = 1e-9*E0 (top88 default)
Classic SIMP E = x^3*E0 with lower bound x_min = 1e-3
Modified SIMP with Emin = 1e-6*E0

items.entity: optimizer, move limit, starting design and stopping rule
items.description: For top88, Sec. 2.3 lists only penal = 3, rmin = 2.4, ft = 1, which fix the filter (a sensitivity filter in top88's convention). No optimizer, move limit, convergence tolerance or iteration cap is given; maxit = 100 is listed only for TOPress.
readings: OC with move limit 0.2 and damping 0.5, uniform start x = Vf, stop when max|dx| < 0.01, no iteration cap (top88 defaults)
Same OC but capped at 100 iterations (mirroring the TOPress maxit)
MMA with a similar change tolerance

items.description: Sec. 2.1/2.3/3.1 mention no passive regions, and Fig. 1(a) cannot be checked for one (e.g. a solid pad at the load or the support).
readings: None: all 100x100 elements are design variables
Small solid non-design pad around the load point and/or along the supported edge
